outlets.name: L'Osservatore Romano
outlets.note: robots.txt lists sitemap.xml, an index of one sitemap per language (sitemap.<lang>.xml, urlsets of the articles under /<lang>/news/). No /feed or /rss (404).

outlets.name: Vatican News
outlets.note: robots.txt lists sitemap.xml, an index of one sitemap per language (sitemap.<lang>.xml). Articles are under /<lang>/<section>/news/; /news/ leaves out the podcasts, the Gospel of the day, the saints and the prayers. No /feed or /rss (404).

outlets.name: Avvenire
outlets.note: Both sitemaps (from robots.txt) redirect to naxosprodstorage.blob.core.windows.net; the news sitemap holds the last days, sitemap.xml an index of monthly story sitemaps. Culture is the Agorà section (/agora/cultura seen). No /feed or /rss (404).

outlets.name: Roma Sette
outlets.note: RSS at /feed/ (the last 10 posts; answered 200 twice on 2026-11-23). /rss answered 403 to our agent, so it is never requested. Article URLs carry no section. sitemap.xml redirects to sitemap_index.xml (Yoast post sitemaps, oldest first): not used.

outlets.name: EWTN
outlets.note: No feed (/feed, /rss 404). sitemap.xml is a single urlset of TV programmes and the Catholicism library (reprints from other publications), not EWTN's journalism; its news is on sister sites (the National Catholic Register is configured; CNA could be added).

outlets.name: La Civiltà Cattolica
outlets.note: sitemap.xml (from robots.txt) answered 403 to our agent on 2026-11-23, as /feed/ did in the recon: refused, not worked around.

outlets.name: Famiglia Cristiana
outlets.note: No /feed or /rss (404). robots.txt lists sitemaps/fc/sitemap_index.xml (news, article, image and video sitemaps); the news sitemap first, for the latest articles. Culture section: /cultura-e-spettacoli/.

outlets.name: Aleteia
outlets.note: One sitemap index per language site (aleteia.org for en, it./es./fr./pt.aleteia.org); robots.txt also lists aleteia.org/news-sitemap.xml, read first for the latest en articles. de.aleteia.org does not resolve (no German edition), so de is not among the languages. Article URLs are /YYYY/MM/DD/slug: no culture section.

outlets.name: National Catholic Register
outlets.note: sitemap.xml redirects to sitemaps/sitemap.xml (the one robots.txt lists), an index whose archive sitemaps are gzipped (.xml.gz, which discovery does not read); sitemap-today.xml from that index is plain XML. No /feed or /rss (404). Sections seen: /features, /cna; no culture section.

outlets.name: KTO
outlets.note: RSS at /rss (programme videos under /video/). robots.txt lists sitemap.txt, plain text that discovery does not read; no sitemap.xml or /feed (404).

outlets.name: SIR
outlets.note: RSS at /feed/ (/rss redirects there; the last 10 items). No sitemap.xml (404). Sections seen: /italia, /chiesa, /diocesi, /mondo, /europa; no culture section.

outlets.name: Gaetano Vallini, Camera con vista
outlets.author: Gaetano Vallini
outlets.note: Blogger blog of a journalist of L'Osservatore Romano who republishes his articles there (`republishes`; a post counts as the newspaper's only when it says so with the issue's date). robots.txt allows all but /search and /share-widget. Only these labels (Fotografia is left out); `walk`: the label's whole archive, newest change first, over successive runs (about 385 posts with the overlaps). The pages are drawn by script and hold no text (nor do ?m=1 and ?v=0), so `article_feed` gives each post's own feed entry. `max_per_run`: articles added and attempted per run, so the archive cannot crowd out the news outlets.
